content.headline: AI tokens for customer replies
content.subheadline: Start with 50,000 free tokens. Customer M-Pesa payments go to your till; token packs cover AI replies on WhatsApp.

plans.name: Starter

plans.features:
100,000 AI tokens
KES 5 per 1,000 tokens
Used when AI answers on WhatsApp

items.question: What do I get when I sign up?
items.answer: Every new store receives 50,000 free AI tokens. The public pricing page says no credit card is required to start.

items.question: How are customer payments handled?
items.answer: WarpCart supports M-Pesa payments. Its pricing page states that customer M-Pesa payments go to your till, while WarpCart charges for AI usage.

items.question: When are tokens used?
items.answer: The published token packs are used when AI answers customers on WhatsApp.

items.question: Can I buy a custom amount?
items.answer: The live pricing page offers custom token amounts. Check WarpCart’s pricing page for the current amount and rate before purchasing.
